                int v = edges[i].to;

                    edgeId[v] = i;

                    }

        for (int v = T; v != S; v = prevNode[v]) {
            flow = min(flow, edges[edgeId[v]].cap);
        }
        
        totalCost += dist[T] * flow;
        for (int v = T; v != S; v = prevNode[v]) {
            edges[edgeId[v]].cap -= flow;
            edges[edgeId[v] ^ 1].cap += flow;
        }
        return true;
    }
}

    T = (r + n + 1) * n + 2;
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= r; i++) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        occ[x]++;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {

    inq[s] = true;
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        inq[u] = false;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < graph[u].size(); ++i) {
            auto& e = graph[u][i];
            if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                prevv[e.to] = u;
                preve[e.to] = i;
                if (!inq[e.to]) {
                    inq[e.to] = true;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (dist[t] >= 0x3f3f3f3f) return {0, false};

    }

        auto& e = graph[prevv[v]][preve[v]];

        graph[v][e.rev].cap += flow;

    return {dist[t] * flow, true};
